page.notes: Left edge fragments ("9.", "ex", "fi-", "s,") are the neighbouring page's edge and were not transcribed. The marks for Quintò (*) and Septimò (b) were read from small superscript signs and are doubtful. "Va" may be "Vae" in print. Printed "mittendum:Si" has no space, transcribed as printed. "VTILES SVMVS" is printed with V for U and is given as UTILES SUMUS per the u/v rule only in the italic text; it is kept as printed here: VTILES SVMVS. Catchword "sunt" and signature "L 2" read from the foot.
